text: Olivia H.: Quick heads-up from user interviews: the in-console help overlay uses a different name than the top nav and external site. Nav reads `Help Center`, overlay header says `Guides & Docs`, and CTAs vary between `Open docs` and `Open help`. New users hesitated. Ken W.: Thanks — same feedback from success calls. We should standardize language so links and tooltips don't contradict each other. Maya (design): My recommendation: keep nav as `Help`, overlay header use `Console guides` with a subline `Examples, tutorials, and API reference`. That keeps the discoverability of "Help" and gives context in the panel. Tom B.: FYI analytics currently reports three events: help_nav_click, overlay_open, external_docs_click. If we rename, we need an event aliasing plan so dashboards still work. I can draft the mapping. help-bot: Draft doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/lexicon-overlay-recommendations (author: @Maya (design)) :spiral_note_pad: Olivia H.: Accessibility items: screen reader doesn't announce expansion state and the overlay traps focus without a visible skip link. Proposed fixes: ``` Skip back to app ``` Ken W.: Also cross-link behavior: clicking an internal anchor (e.g., docs.redwood.ai/#batching) opens a new tab. We should prefer opening the overlay to the anchor when the overlay is available; otherwise fallback to new tab. Could intercept link clicks and attempt overlay.deepLink(anchor). Maya (design): UX note: when deep-linking into the overlay we should nudge the target with a subtle pulse and add a `Return to console` affordance so people don't get lost. I'll add mockups to the doc. Tom B.: Implementation note: plan to parse location.hash or capture clicks, call overlay.open({anchor}), and emit docs_navigation event with fields {anchor, mode: "overlay"|"external", fallback: "true"|"false"}. We'll gate with a feature flag during rollout. Olivia H.: Microcopy idea: use `Open help` in global nav, `Console guides` in overlay header, and `View full docs` for links that leave the app. Keeps tone shorter for UI labels. Ken W.: +1. Can we also update the onboarding tour language and the quickstart tiles to match? Maya (design): I'll update Figma and copy deck. PR with accessibility checklist and the pulse interaction will follow. Tom B.: I'll own the analytics migration and a small shim so older events map to the new names. Will add unit tests for deep link fallback and a11y aria-expanded. Olivia H.: Great. Can we get a short RFC posted to #product-ship by Tuesday with owners and the rollout plan (feature flag + migration steps)? Ken W.: I'll file it and tag @Maya and @Tom. Olivia H.: Thanks team :thumbsup:
